findings: Alto saxophone and orchestra, 1998, duration five minutes; Universal Edition study score UES107220-000.
Inspired by a poem by Nebraska poet Marjorie Saiser. Written for Lawrence Gwozdz, who premiered it with Omaha Symphony under Ernest Richardson.
The preview confirms a substantial orchestral accompaniment including woodwinds, brass, timpani, percussion, harp and strings. Instrument-specific doublings cannot be determined from this excerpt.
